title: Exponential growth and epidemics
summary: A short 3Blue1Brown primer on exponential and logistic growth, using early COVID-19 case data to show how epidemics grow and eventually level off. It explains why small changes in growth rate make enormous differences in outcomes.
why: During the early COVID-19 period, HN commenters linked it as the clearest quick explanation of what exponential growth means for an epidemic.

quote.text: Here is a neat video that helps put things in perspective for most any viewer.
